# n8n Workflow Manager

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/n8n-workflow-manager
Package name: n8n-workflow-manager
Version: 0.2.6
CLI command: n8n-manager
Primary audience: n8n users, workflow automation teams, local-first AI agents, and developers who need to inspect, document, create, or sync n8n workflows.

Summary:
n8n Workflow Manager is a local-first Python package that combines a working visual editor, REST API, CLI, SQLite decision/version history, rollback, Markdown/JSON exports, validated templates, and server-scoped n8n sync. Mutating operations record intent, and clients can read history before changing a workflow.

Related projects:

Verification commands:
- python -m pytest -ra -v (213 passed tests)
- python -m compileall -q n8nManager tests
- python -m ruff check n8nManager tests
- python -m bandit -q -r n8nManager -lll
- python -m build
- python -m n8nManager status
- python -m n8nManager serve --port 8100

Architecture & Invariants:
- 100% Local-First & Zero Egress: binds to 127.0.0.1:8100 by default.
- Non-Elevation: runs with unprivileged user permissions (RunAsInvoker).
- Decision Audit Trail: every mutation records an explicit rationale into an immutable SQLite ledger.
- Deterministic Rollback: complete snapshots are retained for safe reversions.
- Dual-Mermaid Modeling: high-level architecture diagram and interactive sequence diagram with autonumber.
- Bilingual Documentation: 1:1 anchor parity between English (README.md) and German (README_de.md) with 17-point quick navigation.
- Visual Interface Walkthrough: bundled screenshots of dashboard and interactive vis.js graph inspector.
- Target Audience Personas: tailored for sysadmins, AI architects, compliance officers, and SREs.
- 10-Dimension Comparison Matrix: benchmarks against native web UI, git JSON, and REST tools.
- Security SLA: 48h initial response SLA and 5-business-day triage commitment.

Notes:
- This repository is not the n8n project itself. It is a companion manager for imported or connected n8n workflows. It is an independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by n8n GmbH; "n8n" is a trademark of its respective owner.
- The web UI, CLI, REST API and documentation are English. The bundled browser library vis-network is third-party code under its own license, see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
- The web UI is local-first and binds to 127.0.0.1 unless an operator explicitly acknowledges remote exposure.
- The MCP server is maintained separately as n8n-manager-mcp.
- Search engines may surface ellmos-ai/n8n-manager-mcp or third-party n8n deployment tools first; this repository is the Python dashboard and CLI package for visual inspection, documentation export, and multi-server workflow sync.
- Verification status: 210+ Pytest unit, integration & contract tests passing (100% green).
